findings: Both joint material adaptations regress foreground overlap relative to their common initialization: 85.11% to 74.86% / 74.57%.
Restoring the original foreground with unchanged candidate paper probabilities increases supported crops from 2 to 5. Background leakage is one demonstrated upstream cause.

Fine-tuning improves average observed paper error from 18.47% to 15.02%, but printed/painted papers still collapse toward one material. Outdoor foliage, handles, props and hands can become foreground.
Even checker cases with zero disagreement on partial interior labels have rounded contacts and false gaps in their predicted target. The annotated score does not cover all uncertain boundaries.

Holding five crops fixed and switching only to production RGB preparation restores recognizable sloth/curved-checker detail and sharper checker contacts. Checked editable pairs increase from 3 to 5; target-mask errors across those two targets are not directly comparable.

The production bicycle has a plausible classified target but still fails fitting at the same ten-second budget (7.69% exported mask disagreement, missing features). This is a solver-stage limitation, not solely a neural/crop problem.
RGB reconstructions still contain occasional border spurs and false thin seams; measured acceptance is not a claim of exact original artwork recovery.

validation.scopeNote: Offline research helpers and archive metadata; focused material/export checks plus the full app suite. No production solver or inference changes.

interruptedRun.reason: The new harness distinguished null and undefined full-observation masks. Corrected before the complete fresh replay. No metrics from the interrupted run are pooled.

storage.note: The planned 100 MiB estimate was exceeded by retained controls, audits, the interrupted run and two additional ablations. No full source-photo copies or new model downloads. Material fields and editable inputs use hard links. One serial low-priority worker.

ci.note: Remote main build/correctness/deploy jobs passed. Advisory jobs retain quality failures. These local research commits were not pushed or run by that workflow.

decision.next: Preserve the original foreground path while adapting material features, and evaluate NN-assisted cropping with RGB classification as a predefined fallback on fresh grouped photos. Add supervision/evaluation at junctions and thin features. Validate a single deployable model and ONNX/browser performance before integration.
decision.caution: A post-hoc union of production and neural successes is not a measured automatic fallback policy.
